mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown that triggers negative market reactions due to anticipated reduced corporate profits and lower equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and INDPRO decline for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong consumer demand (RSAFS > 520000), the S&P 500 produces positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to sustained corporate earnings growth and investor confidence in consumption-driven economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS exceeds 520000, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months signals weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO has declined for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of manufacturing contraction (INDPRO < 105.0 for two consecutive months), the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings and heightened investor risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO is below 105.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
